author: Southern_Tonight6529
body: Yoon Busan Gukbap in GG…the banchan is excellent and everything is fresh made by og korean ladies. I’m obsessed with their pork ribs…great, but subtle flavor. Every time after (over) eating, you won’t feel disgustingly full. It’s an odd sensation that I quite enjoy and feel like it represents how clean (maybe no grease) the cooking is.
